clips.title: The story
paras: The Hypercapacitor Gizmo is an eccentric piece of engineering recovered from the canyon floor of Thousand Needles. Once dangling from the neck of a caged beast in a ruined caravan, its true purpose remains a mystery even to the tinkerer who claims to own it.

When centaur marauders ambushed a goblin caravan traveling through Thousand Needles, they plundered nearly everything in sight. The sole survivor, Wizlo Bearingshiner, managed to crawl his way to safety at Whitereach Post, leaving behind his best gizmo: the Hypercapacitor Gizmo. Strangely, the gadget wound up secured around the neck of a ferocious, enraged panther locked inside a transport cage. The raiding centaur feared the beast enough to leave the cage entirely alone amidst the burning wreckage, unwittingly preserving Wizlo's odd machine.

While Wizlo proudly calls the device his best gizmo, he admits upon its recovery that he has no real idea what it actually does. Like many goblin contraptions, the Hypercapacitor Gizmo is a tangled mass of ambition and volatile parts, destined to keep its owner occupied with endless tinkering rather than serving any practical, understood function.
